derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in overlap.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Board, first
boxes.derivation: A 24" x 4" x 1" board at the origin: x 0..24, y 0..4, z 0..1.

boxes.name: Board, second
boxes.derivation: The same size at the same place: it occupies exactly the space of the first. Nothing says it may not (assembly-model 6: overlap is not detected by design).

boxes.name: Peg
boxes.derivation: A 1" x 1" peg, 3" tall (depth), passing up through the middle of both boards: x 10..11, y 1 1/2..2 1/2, z 0..3. It shares volume with each board.

cutList.label: Board
cutList.derivation: 24" = 24576, 4" = 4096, 1" = 1024. The two boards are the same size so one row of 2, whether or not they overlap: the cut list counts pieces to cut, not volume of space. Names share "Board, " -> "Board".
